title: The Moon you can walk: the region around the ridge on real terrain
about: Walkable lunar region around Aurora Station and the Cold-Trap approach on the M1-36 LOLA terrain provider (TerrainStream). Covers LOC-06 (mast courtyard), LOC-07 (Expedition Zero annex exterior), LOC-08 (rover garage and landing apron), LOC-09 (cold-trap approach segments B1, B2, B3 and last bend) and LOC-10 (cold-trap vault shelf), plus the 7 places worth visiting from game-design/25_PLAYER_CLARITY_AND_MOON_JOURNEY.md §4.1, each with its structured reason hook (job, clue, view or measurement).

aurora_ridge.description: The Shackleton-de Gerlache connecting ridge around Aurora Station (8 x 8 km at 5 m/px, 64 km vista).

cold_trap.description: The permanently shadowed cold-trap basin and approach road below the ridge (8 x 8 km at 5 m/px).

LOC-06.title: Aurora Mast Courtyard
LOC-06.summary: Aurora's exterior training courtyard with Alo's exterior chamber housing, the twin solar masts, dosimeter post, and route markers.

LOC-07.title: Expedition Zero Annex Exterior
LOC-07.summary: The sealed 2034 Expedition Zero lower service annex surface bulkhead, utility isolation feed, and 2034 survey datum on Aurora's south-west flank.

LOC-08.title: Rover Garage and Landing Apron
LOC-08.summary: Aurora's rover shelter and regolith berm 80 m from the station at azimuth 150 deg, with the rover door opening onto the landing apron and cold-trap road.

LOC-09_B1.title: Cold-Trap Road — Beacon 1 Corner (1.02 km)
LOC-09_B1.summary: First blind ridge corner on the surveyed cold-trap road (1.02 km, slope 2 deg, sunlit at 08:00 UTC).

LOC-09_B2.title: Cold-Trap Road — Beacon 2 Corner (1.88 km)
LOC-09_B2.summary: Second blind ridge corner on the surveyed cold-trap road (1.88 km, slope 6 deg, sunlit at 08:00 UTC).

LOC-09_B3.title: Cold-Trap Road — Beacon 3 Corner (5.24 km)
LOC-09_B3.summary: Third blind corner descending into terrain shadow (5.24 km, slope 9 deg, lit by rover work lights).

LOC-09.title: Cold-Trap Approach — Last Bend Sample Station (7.82 km)
LOC-09.summary: The last bend before the permanently shadowed basin, with the dry reference plate, calibrated ice scanner, and three sample stakes.

LOC-10.title: Cold-Trap Vault Shelf
LOC-10.summary: The 20 x 15 m shelf in permanent shadow holding 2034 Seed Vault V12, the unfaded 2034 marker, tether anchors, and crisp 2034 boot prints.

places_worth_visiting.title: Masts and Solar Arrays
places_worth_visiting.reason_hook: job: inspect twin solar mast generation and clear electrostatic dust at the mast status panel
places_worth_visiting.focus_label: Twin solar masts and array status

places_worth_visiting.title: Landing Pad and Relief Apron
places_worth_visiting.reason_hook: job: verify landing-pad approach beacon and relief-lander handover apron alignment

places_worth_visiting.title: Expedition Zero Survey Markers (2034)
places_worth_visiting.reason_hook: clue: read the 2034 N.R. survey datum tag and trace the sealed Expedition Zero annex utility bulkhead
places_worth_visiting.focus_label: 2034 Expedition Zero annex bulkhead and marker

places_worth_visiting.title: Ridge Ejecta Boulder Field
places_worth_visiting.reason_hook: measurement: log ejecta boulder slope and regolith compaction stakes between the courtyard and Beacon 1

places_worth_visiting.title: Shackleton-de Gerlache Crater Rim Lookout

places_worth_visiting.title: Cold-Trap Shadow Boundary and Sample Station
places_worth_visiting.reason_hook: measurement: calibrate the ice scanner on the dry reference plate and compare hydrogen stakes at the PSR edge

places_worth_visiting.title: Ridge Line-of-Sight Relay and Beacon Site
places_worth_visiting.reason_hook: job: check line-of-sight relay repeater link margin and beacon mast status along the ridge corridor
places_worth_visiting.focus_label: Ridge relay repeater and beacon station
